You must also not be legally barred from driving a ride-sharing vehicle perthe requirements of any applicable law, regulation or ordinance (for example, laws or regulations prohibiting individuals convicted of certain crimes from driving a vehicle through a Transportation Network Company (“TNC”). By accessing the Application, You accept these Terms and Conditions and agree to the terms, conditions, and notices contained and/or referenced herein.

1.        DEFINITIONS

Capitalized terms are defined as set forth below or elsewhere in the Agreement.

1.1 “Services” means the services specified in a Wingz Request for services to be provided by a Driver Client to a Passenger Client; specifically, pre-arranged transportation services using the Application to connect Passenger Clients with Driver Clients who will provide transportation services using the Driver Client’s personal vehicle.

1.2 “Wingz Request” means a notice provided, through the Application, to one or more Driver Clients, which includes a description of the Services to be optionally provided by the Driver Client, the time by which at which the services are to be provided (the “Wingz Completion Date”) and the rate of payment associated with the Wingz Request(the “Payment”). An open request is a request for Services that has not yet been filled (“Open Request”). Driver Clients can use the Application to review Open Requests and optionally decide to accept Open Requests. Once a Driver Client has accepted a Wingz Request pursuant to Section 2, the Wingz Request will become a “Wingz Engagement.”

1.3 “Wingz Mobile Application” or “Application” means the proprietary software application that Wingz licenses to Passenger Clients and Driver Clients to facilitate the provision of Services.

2.         DRIVER CLIENT’S OBLIGATIONS

2.1 Background Checks. As part of Your initial registration with Wingz, You agree to immediately execute a written consent for Wingz to conduct a background check (which may include but not be limited to a criminal history check, motor vehicle record check, and drug and/or alcohol screening) to be conducted by an independent third party. Subject to satisfactory completion of any and all required background checks (which will be conducted in compliance with all applicable laws) and agreement to the terms herein, You will be eligible to use the Wingz Mobile Application to view and accept Wingz Requests. Such background checks also may be conducted at any time while providing Services under these Terms and Conditions.

2.2 Automobile Insurance. You agree to maintain at Your cost automobile insurance valid for transporting passengers arranged through a transportation network company (TNC) and a valid driver’s license. You are advised that personal automobile insurance policies typically do not provide coverage when a driver uses a vehicle in connection with a transportation network company's online-enabled application or platform and that personal automobile insurance policies typically do not provide collision or comprehensive coverage for damage to the vehicle used by the driver when the driver is giving a ride or on his way to go pick up a client who requested a ride through a transportation company. You understand and agree that Wingz’s commercial automobile insurance policy does not provide coverage to You or Your vehicle(s) in the event of an accident or other loss. You further agree that, in the event of an accident while providing services to a Passenger Client, You will comply with any applicable law, ordinance, or regulation; make any required contact with or report to Your insurance carrier; and have available for law enforcement inspection evidence of Your personal insurance and Wingz’s commercial insurance.

2.3 Other Insurance. You acknowledge that You are a Driver Client and as such an independent contractor, not anemployee of Wingz. As such, unless otherwise required by applicable law, ordinance or regulation, You are not covered by any insurance that may be provided by Wingz to its employees, including, without limitation, health insurance, workers’ compensation insurance, general liability insurance, and automobile liability insurance. You also agree that You will not transport more than seven (7) passengers on any one ride (or exceed the maximum occupancy of the vehicle if such maximum occupancy is lower than seven (7)). You further agree that Your vehicle used to provide Services to Passenger Clients is in good operating condition and meets the industry safety standards and all applicable statutory and state department of motor vehicle requirements for a vehicle of its kind and that any and all applicable safety recalls have been or will be remedied per manufacturer instructions. 2.7 Obey All Laws. You agree to follow all applicable laws, ordinances and regulations when providing services to a Passenger Client, including but not limited to obeying all traffic laws and regulations.

2.8 Zero Tolerance Cell Phone Policy. Cell phones should only be used in connection with providing Services while You are providing Services. You must use hands-free technology when making calls while driving and any such calls should be limited to emergency calls only. You are prohibited from activities like texting, browsing the internet, or watching videos on Your phone or any other mobile or electronic device while actively transporting any Passenger Clients or providing any Services under this Agreement, with Your primary focus being on maintaining safe driving practices and minimizing distractions. Using GPS navigation applications is permitted as long as such applications are set up before driving and only voice commands are used while driving. Once a Driver Client has accepted a Wingz Request, the Open Request will no longer be available for performance by other Driver Clients who received the Open Request. By accepting an Open Request, You are entering into a binding legal agreement to provide the Services for the Payment specified in the Open Request. Do not accept an Open Request unless You are sure that You understand what You arebeing asked to deliver, can get to and from the Passenger Client’s location safely, and can deliver the Services in the requested time period.

field_definitions.content: Wingz drivers help transport patients to non-emergency medical appointments using their own vehicle through pre-scheduled trips.

• You'll transport passengers (not packages) to medical appointments
 • Trips are pre-scheduled, helping you plan predictable routes
 • Weekly pay via direct deposit
 • Paid only for miles with a passenger in the vehicle
 • Upfront trip pricing before accepting
 • Multi-load opportunities may increase earnings

field_definitions.content:
✅ 2010+ 4-door vehicle 
✅ Valid driver's license that reflects your current address
✅ Valid Vehicle registration that reflects your current address

field_definitions.content:

 • Reliability and punctuality are essential
 • This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity

 • One vehicle per driver
 • One vehicle at a time policy

💡 Tip: Reading this carefully now helps you move through onboarding faster and avoid delays later.

field_definitions.content:
Q: Do you transport people?
A: Yes. You'll transport passengers, not packages, helping members reach medical appointments safely.

Q: What is this opportunity?
A: This is a professional NEMT opportunity involving pre-scheduled trips and predictable routes.

Q: How do I get paid?
A: Drivers are paid weekly via direct deposit. Trip pay is shown before accepting.

Q: What kind of vehicle do I need?
A: 2010 or newer 4-door vehicle.

Q: Do I need my own vehicle?
A: Yes. Wingz does not provide vehicles.

Q: Do I need to pass a background check and drug screening?
A: Yes, both are required during onboarding.

Q: Am I an independent contractor?
A: Yes. This is a 1099 independent contractor opportunity.

Q: Can I switch vehicles later?
A: Yes — submit updated vehicle documents first for approval before switching.

steps.title: About our driver standards
steps.description: Wingz drivers transport medical patients — many of them elderly, disabled, or headed to critical appointments. Our standards are stricter than typical rideshare because the people in your car are counting on you.

field_definitions.label: Here's what we check before you drive:
field_definitions.content:
**Your driving record.** Moving violations, accidents, DUIs, and license status over the last 3–7 years. You'll need to be at least 25 with at least 1 year of U.S. driving history.

**Your criminal background.** Most offenses are time-gated — typically a 7-year lookback — and include a federal criminal search.

**Lifetime disqualifiers.** A list of serious crimes that disqualify you for life, no matter how long ago.

field_definitions.label: Most applicants are fine. Take a closer look if any of these apply to you:
field_definitions.content:
• A DUI in the last 7 years, or 2 or more DUIs in your lifetime
• Multiple accidents or speeding tickets in the last few years
• A reckless-driving, eluding-police, or suspended-license incident
• A criminal conviction in the last 7 years — including weapons offenses or violating a protective order
• A serious offense at any point in your life — including violence, sex offenses, abuse of a child or elder, stalking, arson, kidnapping, terrorism, fraud, theft, or identity theft (many disqualify for life, no matter how long ago)
• You're under 25, or have less than 1 year of U.S. driving history (a foreign license doesn't count toward driving history)

If any of these sound like your record, **read the full standards before you continue.** They lay out exactly what disqualifies you and when — so you know where you stand.

[Read the full Wingz Driver Standards →](https://help.wingz.me/hc/en-us/articles/49293344363284-Wingz-Driver-Standards)

field_definitions.content:
WINGZ DRIVER SAFETY AND ACCIDENT RESPONSIBILITY POLICY

Effective Date: January 1, 2026

1. SAFETY EXPECTATIONS
All Wingz Drivers are expected to operate their vehicle in a safe and responsible manner at all times, obey all traffic laws, ensure passengers wear seat belts, never use a handheld device while driving, and never drive under the influence.

2. VEHICLE SAFETY REQUIREMENTS
Your vehicle must maintain adequate tread depth, functional lights/signals/mirrors, good brakes, clear windshield, and pass the annual Wingz Vehicle Inspection.

3. ACCIDENT REPORTING PROCEDURE
In the event of any accident while on a Wingz ride, you MUST:
(a) Ensure the safety of all passengers and yourself first.
(b) Call 911 if there are any injuries.
(c) Exchange information with all parties involved.
(d) Report the incident to Wingz within 2 hours via the Driver App or by calling support.
(e) File a police report if required by law.
(f) Do NOT admit fault at the scene.

4. ACCIDENT RESPONSIBILITY
(a) Wingz commercial insurance applies during active rides.
(b) Drivers may be responsible for a deductible of up to $2,500 if at fault.
(c) Repeated at-fault accidents may result in account deactivation.

5. PLATFORM ELIGIBILITY AFTER AN ACCIDENT
(a) Your account may be temporarily suspended pending investigation.
(b) Reinstatement is subject to satisfactory investigation results.
(c) More than 2 at-fault accidents in 12 months = permanent deactivation.

By acknowledging this policy, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to comply with all provisions.

steps.title: About our driver standards
steps.description: Wingz drivers transport medical patients — many of them elderly, disabled, or headed to critical appointments. Our standards are stricter than typical rideshare because the people in your car are counting on you.

field_definitions.label: Here's what we check before you drive:
field_definitions.content:
**Your driving record.** Moving violations, accidents, DUIs, and license status over the last 3–7 years. You'll need to be at least 25 with at least 1 year of U.S. driving history.

**Your criminal background.** Most offenses are time-gated — typically a 7-year lookback — and include a federal criminal search.

**Lifetime disqualifiers.** A list of serious crimes that disqualify you for life, no matter how long ago.

field_definitions.label: Most applicants are fine. Take a closer look if any of these apply to you:
field_definitions.content:
• A DUI in the last 7 years, or 2 or more DUIs in your lifetime
• Multiple accidents or speeding tickets in the last few years
• A reckless-driving, eluding-police, or suspended-license incident
• A criminal conviction in the last 7 years — including weapons offenses or violating a protective order
• A serious offense at any point in your life — including violence, sex offenses, abuse of a child or elder, stalking, arson, kidnapping, terrorism, fraud, theft, or identity theft (many disqualify for life, no matter how long ago)
• You're under 25, or have less than 1 year of U.S. driving history (a foreign license doesn't count toward driving history)

If any of these sound like your record, **read the full standards before you continue.** They lay out exactly what disqualifies you and when — so you know where you stand.

field_definitions.content:
WINGZ DRIVER SAFETY AND ACCIDENT RESPONSIBILITY POLICY

Effective Date: January 1, 2026

1. SAFETY EXPECTATIONS
All Wingz Drivers are expected to operate their vehicle in a safe and responsible manner at all times, obey all traffic laws, ensure passengers wear seat belts, never use a handheld device while driving, and never drive under the influence.

2. VEHICLE SAFETY REQUIREMENTS
Your vehicle must maintain adequate tread depth, functional lights/signals/mirrors, good brakes, clear windshield, and pass the annual Wingz Vehicle Inspection.

3. ACCIDENT REPORTING PROCEDURE
In the event of any accident while on a Wingz ride, you MUST:
(a) Ensure the safety of all passengers and yourself first.
(b) Call 911 if there are any injuries.
(c) Exchange information with all parties involved.
(d) Report the incident to Wingz within 2 hours via the Driver App or by calling support.
(e) File a police report if required by law.
(f) Do NOT admit fault at the scene.

4. ACCIDENT RESPONSIBILITY
(a) Wingz commercial insurance applies during active rides.
(b) Drivers may be responsible for a deductible of up to $2,500 if at fault.
(c) Repeated at-fault accidents may result in account deactivation.

5. PLATFORM ELIGIBILITY AFTER AN ACCIDENT
(a) Your account may be temporarily suspended pending investigation.
(b) Reinstatement is subject to satisfactory investigation results.
(c) More than 2 at-fault accidents in 12 months = permanent deactivation.

By acknowledging this policy, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to comply with all provisions.

field_definitions.label: Benefits Trafficking Training
field_definitions.content:
The Georgia Department of Human Services (DHS) mandates that all Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) drivers complete a 30-minute online training on identifying and reporting signs of Benefits Trafficking. This training is crucial in helping to combat this emerging crime.

Follow the instructions below to complete the course and upload your certificate.

items.text: Access the training by clicking **"Start Training"** below, or go to https://iotis.org/mod/scorm/view.php?id=25247
Click on **"Proceed without logging in"** — **DO NOT CLICK Log In.**
Click the course titled **"DAS 500 - Benefits Trafficking for Non-Emergency Medical Transportation"** to begin.
Follow along carefully, listen to all the narrative audio, and answer the knowledge check questions at the end of each section.
After the final quiz, click Next to reach the Certification page. Enter your full name, then click Print to save the certificate to your device.
Upload your certificate below.

The following safety items are required for the vehicle compliance inspection and must be available in the vehicle when providing trips through the Wingz platform.

Please have these items ready within 10 days so the inspection can be scheduled without delay. Inspectors will verify you have these items in the vehicle during inspection.

You may obtain these items from any retailer or brand of your choice. Some commonly used options include Amazon, Walmart, auto parts stores, home improvement stores, and similar retailers.

Need help finding or buying any of these? Reach out to us via Chat and we'll point you in the right direction.

field_definitions.label: How to Schedule Your Vehicle Inspection
field_definitions.content:
Your vehicle inspection is carried out by Bright Inspect. Read the requirements below before booking — you will be asked to confirm you have read them, and then you can book your appointment and tell us when it is.

Bring everything listed below to the appointment. The inspector checks the vehicle in person and verifies that the required safety equipment is actually in it.

field_definitions.label: I have read the inspection requirements, and I understand the $40 reservation hold and when it can be charged.

validation_rules.requiredMessage: Please confirm you have read the inspection requirements before booking.

field_definitions.content:
PRINTED MATERIALS TO BRING
• Wingz Trade Dress, printed in colour on 8.5 x 11 paper
• Interior Safety Rules signage, printed on letter paper
• A penny — the inspector uses it for the tire tread test

VEHICLE CONDITION REQUIREMENTS
• Tires pass the penny tread test
• No cracks in the windshield
• Air conditioning works
• Headlights, taillights, signal lights and warning lights all work
• No significant interior or exterior damage — dents, rust, or doors that do not open and close properly
• No third-party advertising stickers — product, company or political
• Interior and exterior are clean

RESERVATION HOLD — $40
• Bright Inspect asks for a payment card to reserve your slot and places a $40 hold. The hold is temporary and is released if your vehicle passes.
• If your vehicle does not pass, you have 72 hours to fix the issues and re-book at no extra charge.
• The hold may be charged if you do not pass within 72 hours of the first failure, or if you book and then fail to cancel or reschedule at least 3 hours before the appointment.
• If the hold is charged, a new paid appointment is required.

items.text: Click **"Book your Vehicle Inspection"** below to open Bright Inspect.
Choose an available appointment slot.
Enter a payment card to reserve the slot. Bright Inspect places a **$40 hold** — see the reservation hold notice above.
Record the date and time of your appointment below.
The inspection is in person — bring the vehicle.
Bring the printed materials, the penny, and all required safety equipment listed above.
The inspector verifies that the required safety equipment is actually in the vehicle.
